title: Verify European conditional lookup production CLI
changes: Record production CLI registration, creation and reuse of the e96-d95 EUR conditional lookup dataset.
validation: One isolated Windows build and one focused Wine create/reuse/startup sequence passed: 87 files match the accepted dataset, 86 runtime identities match, and managed files and guarded inputs remain unchanged.
limitations: This does not prove ordinary lookup use; Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified. No performance measurements.
